limitations: Shape-only data uses random hidden/input IDs and actual frozen target embedding/head. It does not measure natural-image training.
Small correctness saved first-update output/loss/all gradients; its CPU copy and disk save overhead is included in first pilot timing, excluded from measured3 updates.
Natural samples only <=825 tokens; padding to4096 is not a4096 real context.
No full-decoder/MLP checkpoint. Checkpoint scope only mask materialization plus SDPA; repeated K/V outside.

All pre-disconnection NPU rows used direct BF16 AdamW. Archived preflight_BF16optimizer_not_final; not final capacity/HBM evidence. The final complete FP32-master matrix was rerun after SSH restoration and is recorded in summary.json.
optimizer: Production audit_common.create_optimizer/optimizer_step FP32 masters/moments, BF16 live parameters. Formal lr6e-4 betas.9/.95 wd0 warmup.04 minlr.1; fixed8update diagnostic horizon.
checkpoint_scope: Mask materialization plus SDPA only. K/V head repetition is outside checkpoint. No MLP, projection, whole-layer, or loss checkpoint.
baseline_scope: Harness dense comparators use the same DFlashMaskSpec and explicit SDPA/GQA dispatch as chunked, with one full-query call per layer; they are not the stock HF dense-mask-once trainer dispatch. Dense masks are materialized separately per attention layer.
execution_environment_note: NPU1 was exclusively assigned to B. Separate recipe work ran concurrently on NPU0 and shared host CPU/RAM. Host-side concurrency may affect update timing; all B cells completed, no B OOM. No speedup or discovered capacity-boundary claim.
